SELECT SEQ_MTNG_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_MTNG ( MTNG_ID, MTNG_NM, MTNG_TYPE_CD, CRTR_ID, BEGIN_DT, END_DT, CREAT_DT, DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{mtngId}, #{mtngNm}, #{mtngTypeCd}, #{crtrId}, #{beginDt}, #{endDt}, #{creatDt}, #{delYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT M.MTNG_ID, M.MTNG_NM, M.MTNG_TYPE_CD, M.BEGIN_DT, M.END_DT, M.CRTR_ID, E.EMP_NM AS CRTR_NM, M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID, CR.CONF_RM_NM, V.VCONF_ID, V.ROOM_NM, MM.MOM_ID, MM.MOM_STTUS_CD FROM TB_MTNG M LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = M.CRTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONF_RM_RSRV R ON R.RSRV_ID = M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONF_RM CR ON CR.CONF_RM_ID = R.CONF_RM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_VIDEO_CONF V ON V.MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG_MOM MM ON MM.MOM_ID = ( SELECT MAX(MOM_ID) FROM TB_MTNG_MOM WHERE MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID AND DEL_DT IS NULL ) LEFT JOIN TB_VIDEO_RCRDG VR ON VR.VCONF_ID = V.VCONF_ID AND VR.DEL_DT IS NULL WHERE M.MTNG_ID = #{mtngId} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT P.MTNG_PTCPT_ID, P.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM, J.JOB_GRD_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID FROM TB_MTNG_PTCPT P INNER JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = P.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE J ON J.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD WHERE P.MTNG_ID = #{mtngId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MTNG SET MTNG_NM = #{mtngNm}, MTNG_TYPE_CD = #{mtngTypeCd}, BEGIN_DT = #{beginDt}, END_DT = #{endDt}, CONF_RM_RSRV_ID = #{confRmRsrvId} WHERE MTNG_ID = #{mtngId}
mapper.select: SELECT M.MTNG_ID, M.MTNG_NM, M.MTNG_TYPE_CD, M.BEGIN_DT, M.END_DT, M.CRTR_ID, E.EMP_NM AS CRTR_NM, M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID, CR.CONF_RM_NM, V.VCONF_ID, V.ROOM_NM, MM.MOM_ID, MM.MOM_STTUS_CD FROM TB_VIDEO_CONF V INNER JOIN TB_MTNG M ON M.MTNG_ID = V.MTNG_ID AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = M.CRTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONF_RM_RSRV R ON R.RSRV_ID = M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONF_RM CR ON CR.CONF_RM_ID = R.CONF_RM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG_MOM MM ON MM.MOM_ID = ( SELECT MAX(MOM_ID) FROM TB_MTNG_MOM WHERE MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID AND DEL_DT IS NULL ) WHERE V.VCONF_ID = #{vconfId}
